new_results.statement: Under the q/2 physical cross-range leverage condition, every exterior-power energy e_m(BB^T)>0 with integer m>2q yields a continuous density bound K_{m,q} e_m(BB^T)^(-1/(2m)).

For A=U Lambda U^T spanning its entire range, MSS plus the exterior-power bound gives [K_{m,q}/delta(rho)] e_m(Lambda^2)^(-1/(2m)) whenever q>=max(1,2rho/delta), q<2, and m>2q. Arbitrary extra eigenvalues may have either sign and any nonzero size.

unresolved_implication: Exhaustive heavy/light original-coordinate reduction from only three large eigenvalues; current theorem still assumes a diffuse entire-range leverage condition or an already-certified physical cross block.
